title: Improved Minor Illusion
categories: Spells that can be cast while silenced
html:
Improved Minor Illusion is a cantrip (Illusion). It is an upgraded version of  Minor Illusion available to Illusion School wizards which only costs a  Bonus Action.

Description

You can cast  Minor Illusion as a bonus action.

 Bonus Action

Notes

  • You can remain hidden while casting this spell.
  • This spell can be cast while you are  Silenced
